dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Oh? Now this is a first. Who goes to the Akademiya in the middle of a festival?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: This is the only place where I can escape all the commotion.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Go have your fun, and don't tell anyone you saw me here.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: These festivals don't come by often, so you might as well let me enjoy it in my own way.

choices.text: You're not going to join in on the fun?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Do I strike you as someone who wants to hold hands and dance with everyone?
